comparison.order_policy: alternate incumbent/challenger then challenger/incumbent per case across exploration and confirmation

timing.scope: one fresh paired runner process per candidate and case per block; three caller-level forward/VJP warmups; primary is host-wall time for 30 uninstrumented forward/VJP calls plus one final stream synchronization, divided by 30; includes launch, tape, output/gradient reductions and synchronization amortized over calls; excludes preparation, upload/conversion and optimizer work; event-timed forward/backward/VJP vectors are secondary diagnostics only
